title: Patch 1.6
headline: A new audio mix, free basic defenses, and a more useful server browser.
highlights: Combat audio, distant gunfire and spawn sounds were reworked. Units can now field two Medics; Rifleman slots drop from three to two.
Level 1 Engineer defenses no longer cost supplies; upgrades still do. Barricades, bunkers and wire have revised designs and placement limits.
Server filters and favourites receive fixes, fuller servers are prioritised, and visible-by-default Vote Kick notifications get a 30-second response window.
Further helicopter controls, spectator camera, artillery, effects-related stability and map corrections are included.
caution: The notes do not explicitly close the voice-volume slider, Frame Generation reapplication or tutorial-completion saving issues. Those remain separate tracker records.
review_basis: Official Patch 1.6 publisher text reviewed on Steam, with the matching official website post; selected highlights only.

title: Hotfix 1.5.2
scope: All platforms; FSR support is hardware-specific
headline: Server reliability, voice safeguards, lower memory use and AMD FSR 4.1.
highlights: Replication changes target degradation during long server sessions; voice changes reduce cases of players becoming silently muted.
Additional crash fixes and reduced memory use are joined by FSR 4.1 support for the AMD hardware specified in the notes.
Settings are retained through EOS sign-out/sign-in; PS5 save-data safeguards and a correction for nearby trees using flat distant models are included.
caution: Safeguards and improvements are not blanket closure of every crash, spawn, voice or save problem. The publisher advises PC players to let shader caching finish after updating.
review_basis: Official Hotfix 1.5.2 publisher text reviewed on Steam and the tracker’s cited release evidence.

title: Hotfix 1.5.1
headline: A steadier view when aiming and restored M14/SKS controller feedback.
highlights: Aiming transitions were adjusted to reduce distracting changes in shadows and object detail when entering aim-down-sights.
Vibration and haptics were restored for the M14 and SKS; mounted-gun movement received further smoothing.
The boat nameplate now uses the correct icon.
caution: Mounted-weapon smoothing does not resolve every deployment or aiming complaint; the notes themselves leave further work open.
date_note: Steam announces the release on September 22; the website post is dated September 21. This archive uses the live-announcement date.
review_basis: Official Hotfix 1.5.1 live-announcement text reviewed on Steam.

title: Update 1.5
headline: The licensed Huey, M14 and SKS arrive alongside weapon balancing and fixes.
highlights: The Bell UH-1 Iroquois Huey, its radio feature, and the M14 and Type 56 SKS expand the available content.
The first launch-weapon balancing pass accompanies changes to helicopter play, Commander Orders, spawning and the Tactical Map.
Specific fixes include duplicate input assignments, mouse-wheel binding, destroyed-boat visibility and helicopter rotors damaging structures.
caution: The destroyed-boat visibility correction is narrower than every ghost-boat report. This release is not recorded as proof that tutorial completion saving is fully fixed.
date_note: The full notes were published before launch; the official live announcement establishes September 16 as the release date.
source_title: Update 1.5 | Full Changelog | Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
review_basis: Official Update 1.5 changelog and September 16 live-announcement text reviewed on Steam, alongside existing linked issue evidence.

title: Hotfix 1.4.2
headline: Targeted audio, voice, crash and mounted-gun corrections.
highlights: PC spatial-audio reverb and repeated voice sounds when closing radio communications or opening menus receive specific fixes.
Several crash paths and camera-related stutter on mounted weapons are addressed.
Tunnel links to pre-placed Garrisons regain distance restrictions, and Windows Store players regain the DLSS reconstruction option.
caution: These are specific corrections, not proof that every audio failure, GPU crash or mounted-weapon complaint is resolved.
source_title: Hotfix 1.4.2 | Live Now | Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
review_basis: Official Hotfix 1.4.2 text reviewed on Steam and previously recorded issue-linked release evidence.

title: Patch 1.4
scope: PC and consoles; graphics features depend on hardware
headline: Robotic proximity voice, persistent recon markers and progression safeguards.
highlights: The main robotic Proximity Chat defect and one identified cause of persistent Recon Plane and Flare markers receive changes.
Additional protection targets unexpected Career Level resets, alongside fixes for a blood/effects-related crash path.
Aiming inversion is separated from vehicle controls, and an incorrect non-VIP party slot warning is corrected.
caution: The recon change addresses one cause, and progression changes are safeguards. Neither establishes universal resolution.
date_note: The official website dates these notes September 2; Steam lists its live post September 3. The date above identifies the website record, not a proven simultaneous rollout time.
source_title: Patch 1.4 | Full Changelog | Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
review_basis: Selected highlights from the tracker’s previously reviewed, issue-linked Patch 1.4 evidence. This pass checks the official destination but is not a fresh full-source audit.

title: Patch 1.3
scope: PC and consoles; community-server changes included
headline: More reliable server administration, vehicle controls and combat interactions.
highlights: VIP lists are retained through server resets, Map Shuffle is corrected, and inaccurate zero-ping browser readings receive a fix.
Tank drivers can change gears without holding the throttle, and helicopter co-pilots retain control after the pilot dies.
Fixes cover several tunnel/water soft locks and KIA-screen voice interruptions, with further knife-hit, controls and map improvements.
caution: A targeted fix for wiped server settings was not explicitly confirmed in the final notes. It remains separate from the released VIP-list fix.
source_title: Patch 1.3 | Full Changelog | Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
review_basis: Selected highlights from the tracker’s previously reviewed, issue-linked Patch 1.3 evidence. This pass checks the official destination but is not a fresh full-source audit.

title: Patch 1.2
scope: PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
headline: Launch-era server, voice, movement and vehicle problems receive fixes.
highlights: A reproduced server crash involving tunnel changes during travel is fixed; this is a specific cause rather than all server disconnects.
Party Voice Chat and voice controls, deployment without a weapon, and an unusable helicopter gunner seat receive corrections.
Changes also address above-ground swimming, underwater helicopter operation, a brief Xbox driving freeze, and VIP slot accounting.
caution: This is historical release evidence. Similar symptoms reported on later builds still need their own investigation.
